## What changes

A short description of what changes for a page that uses the component.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for the change (a suite under `test/`, or a unit test)
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` run, and `npm run test:dist` passes
- [ ] Documentation updated (`docs/`, the README's table)
- [ ] An entry under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`
